title: DriveVLM: The Convergence of Vision-Language Models and Autonomous Driving
abstract: This synthetic example paper studies how vision-language models are adapted to autonomous driving. It proposes a scene description module, a language-grounded planning head, and reports qualitative results on a synthetic driving benchmark. The abstract is placeholder text used only for local smoke testing of Hy-SurveyAgent.

title: Language-Grounded Trajectory Prediction with Multimodal Transformers
abstract: This synthetic example paper formulates trajectory prediction as a language-conditioned sequence modelling problem. A multimodal transformer fuses camera tokens with textual route instructions, and the authors compare against a camera-only baseline on a synthetic dataset.

title: A Taxonomy of Vision-Language Perception for End-to-End Driving
abstract: This synthetic example paper surveys design choices for vision-language perception stacks in end-to-end driving, organising prior work into prompt-based, embedding-based, and agent-based categories, and discusses evaluation protocols and open problems.
